name: Warning
description: An unusual condition without actual operational impact.

name: Minor
description: A small defect or degraded behavior that is safe to leave temporarily.

name: Major
description: A significant problem where the system can continue, but repair should generally be prioritized within the day.

name: Critical
description: The affected component cannot safely continue its normal function or is repeatedly crashing.
typical_response: A higher-level system may stop, restart, or isolate the component.

name: Emergency
description: The highest machine-handled severity; immediate attention is required.
typical_response: Higher-level orchestration may pre-empt lower-priority work.

name: Human
description: Full autonomous resolution must not proceed; human intervention is required.
typical_response: Preserve safe operation and require human intervention.
